svg.title: Connected structure with full triage split: ingest, Q&A, and graph joined through SQLite
svg.desc: A tall structured diagram. Top band is the detailed ingest write path with triage branching explicitly into clean text, table, and vision routes that converge into the SQLite upsert, then summary, XBRL, LLM extraction and reconcile. Middle is the SQLite hub. Bottom splits into the phase 3 Q&A flow on the left and the phase 4 graph and monitoring flow on the right, both reading from the hub.

g.text: SQLite — the single source of truth
